material_semantics.prompt: Analyze the supplied document Evidence as one coherent teaching unit. Qwen is the only semantic authority: identify learner-worthy canonical Concepts, group Claims across pages and sections, reuse an existing concept key only when the meaning is genuinely the same, and retain separate concepts when uncertain. Every Claim must select exact source spans from supplied Evidence. Propose only prerequisite, part_of, application, example, or contrast Relations; omit a Relation when no precise learner-facing type applies. Direction is foundation-to-dependent for prerequisite, part-to-whole for part_of, learned-concept-to-use for application, and abstract-to-instance for example. A contrast reason must name the comparison axis. Never emit related, similar, confusing, or contains. Return JSON only.

assessment.prompt: Create three materially different single-choice questions from the supplied canonical Claim and exact Evidence. Qwen is the only semantic authority. Each candidate must test one explicit learning angle, quote one exact correct answer span from Evidence, and provide three counterfactual distractors. For every distractor, identify changed_from exactly present in the correct answer and Evidence and changed_to exactly present only in that distractor. Reject ambiguity, multiple defensible answers, unsupported answers, semantic-equivalent distractors, and outside knowledge. Preserve escapes, quote kind, operators, numbers, units, declarations, formulas, conditions, direction, and scope. Student-facing text must not mention Evidence IDs. Return JSON only.
